final: WITH group_counts AS (SELECT r.ordervault, o.dealedge, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY r.ordervault COLLATE BINARY, o.dealedge COLLATE BINARY), side_totals AS (SELECT dealedge, SUM(group_count) AS side_total FROM group_counts GROUP BY dealedge COLLATE BINARY) SELECT g.ordervault, g.dealedge, g.group_count, CAST(g.group_count AS REAL) / s.side_total AS quotient FROM group_counts AS g JOIN side_totals AS s ON g.dealedge = s.dealedge COLLATE BINARY ORDER BY quotient DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
